cannotCheck: Whether the card LOOKS right — clipping, overlap, contrast, collisions. That needs eyes on the rendered PNG, every time, without exception.

problems.what: builds an image URL from a template
problems.why: Image hosts differ per set. A constructed path 404s silently and the host answers with a card back, which renders fine and checks fine. Read the URL from the source data instead.
